question: How many PTO days do I get per year?
rag_answer: All full‑time employees receive 20 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per calendar year. PTO accrues at 1.67 days per month starting on your first day of employment. If you’re a part‑time employee, the allowance is prorated.

You receive 15 paid time‑off (PTO) days per year as a new employee.  
After each full year of service, you earn an additional day, up to a maximum of 25 days.  
If you have any questions about your specific accrual schedule, just let me know!

question: How long do I have to submit an expense report?
rag_answer: You must submit your expense report within 30 days of the purchase date. If you wait longer, the expense may not be reimbursed.
